review.assessment: The change replaces the two nested `.includes()` calls with pre-constructed `Set` lookups (`inB` for membership in `b`, `seen` for deduplication during iteration over `a`). This drops per-element scanning from O(N) to O(1), achieving overall O(M+N) linear time while strictly preserving the order of first appearance and eliminating duplicates. Host acceptance tests passed with no regressions.
